_meta.purpose: Cross-project MCP servers that must work from any cwd (briefing, email-cleanup) — NOT tied to the FinalMindAI/quovy repo. Registered at USER scope, launched from repo-local vendored runtimes via mcp/with-env.
_meta.schema: stdio server = {kind:stdio, runtime:node|python, bin:<node_modules/.bin or .venv/bin name>, args:[...], needs_env:[...]}. http server = {kind:http, url, headers?}. `_desc`/`_prereq` are documentation.
_meta.secrets_rule: Secrets are provided at launch by mcp/with-env from ../.env (op:// references or literals) using each server's own env-var name. Never inline a token here or in ~/.claude.json.

slack._prereq: Already registered at user scope on this machine. Re-register only if you want it launched from the vendored runtime; needs SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN in .env.

auth.instructions: One-time Google OAuth (~2 min) to mint Gmail credentials.
auth.doc: Full steps: README → "Servers that need extra setup" (gmail).

gmail._desc: Gmail read + modify (archive/labels) + filter CRUD. Used by email-cleanup.
gmail._prereq: One-time OAuth: create a Desktop OAuth client, set GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH/GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH in .env (absolute paths), run the auth flow once to mint credentials (scopes: gmail.modify + gmail.settings.basic).
